data.name: Dreamshaper
data.description: You can manipulate the dreamscape of others, drawing forth or tampering with their subconscious minds. This power allows you to tamper with the target's memories as if using modify memory, or you may ask questions as if using speak with dead upon a corpse. A successful Will save negates the effect. The DC of this save is %1, with further modifiers as the nightmare spell.|Sorcerer_DreamspunDreamshaper_DC
